name: Guardian cryptic crossword, Penguin book 11 No 8

clue.text: Giving senior NCO everything with little hesitation — not major though
A note about 5 down written badly but with a will
Players all
Stick around or a pupil will make music of a sort
Bluster and rage on car breaking down
A woman editor with aspiration should admit it
A boat backing water
Noah kept spinners busy!
Perfectly happy just to read when camping
Poke around for all to see in vain
A step to be effected without delay
Coloured, being much attached to an old house
His plight could well be a warning to people in the main
A dunderhead with German following will get let in
Extravagant poetry writer?
Grieved — so long in the red
Governors formerly appearing a bit retrogressive on board
Using no net for a time
Telling stories in gratitude — only in gratitude
Conscience-stricken, having cribbed article in the break
Discrimination that makes sense
A fleshy-leaved plant producing weighty harvest
A means of transport, one for little mites
The Orient — certainly torrid as far as anybody can see
The page didn’t like being put on show
Incorrectly parked in outside carpark, which is criminal!
Dresses a guy — he’s there to ensure the knot’s properly tied
Rachel’s novel ‘The Prince’
